pictures.viewed: Inspected1280x960 piazza facade: seven tall upper windows (central triangular, others curved hoods), giant pale stone pilasters, paired round supports and deep open rectangular ground portico, terracotta/ochre wall fields, deep cornice and open balustrade. Roof figures represented only by original simple abstractions. Rear roofs not established by this front photograph.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Complete connected Conservatori/Caffarelli museum building group on the standard mapped parent and eight integral parts. Seven-bay eastern piazza facade with giant stone pilasters, real recessed ground portico, paired Ionic column proxies, pedimented upper windows, deep cornice and balustrade; open mapped internal courtyard, irregular connected rear ranges, terracotta roofs and a modern curved hall roof proxy. Original simplified roof figures; no copied statues, art, text or furnished galleries.
